integrity: All finite arithmetic and orbit enumeration are reproduced by the embedded standalone standard-library verifier. The motivating overall counting theorem and previously known F8 witness are credited, not claimed as new.
scientific_limitations: An exact n=9, linear-subspace orbit classification; no general-degree theorem, no new overall count, and no claim of independent validation. Earlier equivalent orbit tables cannot be completely excluded.
title: Exact semilinear orbit classification of zero-Welch three-spaces over \(\mathbb F_{512}\)
